description_en: Creates a time-based elastic scaling plan
kebab_example: aliyun hologram create-warehouse-schedule-task --instance-id hgpostcn-cn-lbj33559x001 --warehouse-id 1 --start-time 0100 --end-time 0200 --elastic-cu 32 --description user_stat --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWarehouseScheduleTask

parameters.help_en: The description of the time-based elastic scaling plan
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The number of elastic CPU cores. The value must be a multiple of 16, and must be greater than or equal to 16 and less than or equal to the specifications of the current compute group
parameters.help_zh: 弹性 CPU 核数，必须是 16 的整数倍，且大于等于 16、小于等于当前计算组规格
parameters.name: elastic_cu

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is in the HHmm format (four digits, 24-hour clock) and must be on the hour or half hour, such as 0030, 0100, or 0400. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。格式为 HHmm（四位数字，24 小时制），只能是整点或半点，比如 0030、0100、0400。
结束时间必须大于开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is in the HHmm format (four digits, 24-hour clock) and must be on the hour or half hour, such as 0030, 0100, or 0400
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。格式为 HHmm（四位数字，24 小时制），只能是整点或半点，比如 0030、0100、0400
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The compute group ID. You can call ListWarehouses to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 计算组 ID，可通过 ListWarehouses 获取
parameters.name: warehouse_id

Data.description_en: The creation result. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Data.description_zh: 创建结果。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request parameters for creating a time-based elastic scaling plan
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 创建分时弹性计划的请求参数
v1_body_parameters.name: body
